This document outlines the maintenance inspection on boiler feed 
water pump, which must be performed every one year
This procedure was applied in damanhour unit 300 MW since 1990

The first draft initiated by eng. El-Said Mohamed Madareed, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by director eng. Hamdy Dorgam of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania: WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.

items:
A work permit must be 
 issued

Use safety fences with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area

Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes, earplug, and gloves pairs

The motor must be out 
 of service
Suitable tool set, air blower meager device

Ensure that all fixing 
bolts are secure

Ensure that electrical 
connection are tight

Check the isolators and 
clean it

Check for water leaks 
clean cooler fins (air side)

Visually inspection for 
winding and clean it

Measure winding 
insulation resistance every 2 year

Check all protection 
devices of the motor by protection group

text:
Protection
Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance inspection on boiler feed 
water pump, which must be performed every one year
This procedure was applied in damanhour unit 300 MW since 1990
Specification
Rating power (5800 kw)
Amper (615.07 A)
R.P.M (1489)
Type : CR 710 Y4
Connection (Y)
PF (0.88)
The first draft initiated by eng. El-Said Mohamed Madareed, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by director eng. Hamdy Dorgam of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania: WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued
Use safety fences with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area
Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes, earplug, and gloves pairs
The motor must be out 
 of service
Circuit breaker in test 
 position
Tools and 
Equipment
Suitable tool set, air blower meager device
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Brushes (soft brushes)
Work to be carried out
Ensure that all fixing 
bolts are secure
Ensure that electrical 
connection are tight
Check the isolators and 
clean it
Check for water leaks 
clean cooler fins (air side)
Check for oil leaks
Clean cooler tubes 
(water side)
Visually inspection for 
winding and clean it
Measure winding 
insulation resistance every 2 year
Check all protection 
devices of the motor by protection group
